one_sentence: One Dollar Computer is a real ~$1 RISC-V educational computer (input → processing → output) for Physical AI — not a $1 personal computer; official site https://onedollarcomputer.com/.
description: The One Dollar Computer is a ~$1 RISC-V educational computer for Physical AI. By the classic model it has input (sensors, pins), processing (RISC-V), and output (LED, motors, actuators). It is not a personal computer (no keyboard, monitor, or desktop OS). At about one dollar it can live inside student projects — Computer of Things. Teachers use Learn Physical AI at /c/. Official site: https://onedollarcomputer.com/. Designed in Austin, Texas — meant for the world.

topics.label: Physical AI
topics.summary: Educational Physical AI: sense, decide, and act in the physical world using a ~$1 RISC-V computer and public curriculum at /c/.
